38540-a-scout-of-to-day.title: A Scout Of To-Day
38540-a-scout-of-to-day.creator: Unknown
38540-a-scout-of-to-day.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Colin Estey stretched his well-developed fourteen-year-old body among the tall feathery grasses of the broad salt-marsh whereon he lay, kicking his heels in the September sunshine, and gazed longingly off toward the grand expanse of New England woodland that bordered the marshes and, rising into tree-clad hills, stretched away much farther than the eye could reach in apparently illimitable majesty.

arxiv-2104-03404.title: Bootstrapping of memetic from genetic evolution via inter-agent selection pressures
arxiv-2104-03404.creator: Nicholas Guttenberg, Marek Rosa
arxiv-2104-03404.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nicholas Guttenberg, Marek Rosa. We create an artificial system of agents (attention-based neural networks) which selectively exchange messages with each-other in order to study the emergence of memetic evolution and how memetic evolutionary pressures interact with genetic evolution of the network weights. We observe that the ability of agents to exert selection pressures on each-other is essential for memetic evolution to bootstrap itself into a state which has both high-fidelity replication of memes, as well as continuing production of new memes over time.

arxiv-2105-14373.title: Sentiment analysis in tweets: an assessment study from classical to modern text representation models
arxiv-2105-14373.creator: Sérgio Barreto, Ricardo Moura, Jonnathan Carvalho, Aline Paes, Alexandre Plastino
arxiv-2105-14373.description: Abstract With the growth of social medias, such as Twitter, plenty of user-generated data emerge daily. The short texts published on Twitter – the tweets – have earned significant attention as a rich source of information to guide many decision-making processes.

arxiv-2106-03200.title: Weighted Hardy Type inequalities with Robin Boundary Conditions
arxiv-2106-03200.creator: Ismail Kombe and Abdullah Yener
arxiv-2106-03200.description: Abstract . In this paper we establish a general weighted Hardy type inequality for the p − p- Laplace operator with Robin boundary condition. We provide various concrete examples to illustrate our results for different weights. Furthermore, we present some Heisenberg-Pauli-Weyl type inequalities with boundary terms on balls with radius R R at the origin in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} .

arxiv-2111-15377.title: Passivity of Electrical Transmission Networks modelled using Rectangular and Polar D-Q variables
arxiv-2111-15377.creator: Kaustav Dey, A. M. Kulkarni
arxiv-2111-15377.description: Abstract The increasing penetration of converter-interfaced distributed energy resources has brought out the need to develop decentralized criteria that would ensure the small-signal stability of the inter-connected system. Passivity of the D-Q admittance or impedance is a promising candidate for such an approach. It is facilitated by the inherent passivity of the D-Q impedance of an electrical network.

arxiv-2204-07397.title: An exploration of dust grain growth within WCd systems using an advected scalar dust model
arxiv-2204-07397.creator: J. W. Eatson, J. M. Pittard, S. Van Loo
arxiv-2204-07397.description: Abstract Dust production is one of the more curious phenomena observed in massive binary systems with interacting winds. The high temperatures, UV photon flux and violent shocks should destroy any dust grains that condense. However, in some extreme cases dust production yields of approximately 30% of the total mass loss rate of the stellar winds have been observed.

arxiv-2210-07145.title: Accurate, reliable and interpretable solubility prediction of druglike molecules with attention pooling and Bayesian learning
arxiv-2210-07145.creator: Seongok Ryu, Sumin Lee
arxiv-2210-07145.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Seongok Ryu, Sumin Lee. In drug discovery, aqueous solubility is an important pharmacokinetic property which affects absorption and assay availability of drug. Thus, in silico prediction of solubility has been studied for its utility in virtual screening and lead optimization. Recently, machine learning (ML) methods using experimental data has been popular because physics-based methods like quantum mechanics and molecular dynamics are not suitable for high-throughput tasks due to its computational costs.

arxiv-2302-07022.title: Late-time cosmology in a model of modified gravity with an exponential function of the curvature
arxiv-2302-07022.creator: A. Oliveros, Mario A. Acero
arxiv-2302-07022.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. Oliveros, Mario A. Acero. In this work, we analyse the late-time evolution of the Universe for a particular f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity model built from an exponential function of the scalar curvature. Following the literature, we write the field equations in terms of a suited statefinder function ( y H ​ ( z ) y_{H}(z) ) and considering well motivated physical initial conditions, the resulting equations are solved numerically.

arxiv-2406-02422.title: IterMask 2 \rm{IterMask^{2}} : Iterative Unsupervised Anomaly Segmentation via Spatial and Frequency Masking for Brain Lesions in MRI
arxiv-2406-02422.creator: Ziyun Liang 1, Xiaoqing Guo 1, J. Alison Noble 1, Konstantinos Kamnitsas 1,2,3
arxiv-2406-02422.description: Abstract Unsupervised anomaly segmentation approaches to pathology segmentation train a model on images of healthy subjects, that they define as the ‘normal’ data distribution. At inference, they aim to segment any pathologies in new images as ‘anomalies’, as they exhibit patterns that deviate from those in ‘normal’ training data. Prevailing methods follow the ‘corrupt-and-reconstruct’ paradigm.

arxiv-2406-11585.title: Bayesian regression discontinuity design with unknown cutoff
arxiv-2406-11585.creator: Julia Kowalska, Mark van de Wiel, Stéphanie van der Pas
arxiv-2406-11585.description: Abstract The regression discontinuity design (RDD) is a quasi-experimental approach used to estimate the causal effects of an intervention assigned based on a cutoff criterion. RDD exploits the idea that close to the cutoff units below and above are similar; hence, they can be meaningfully compared. Consequently, the causal effect can be estimated only locally at the cutoff point.

arxiv-2411-01672.title: Atomistic modeling of diffusion processes at Al(Si)/Si(111) interphase boundaries obtained by vapor deposition
arxiv-2411-01672.creator: Yang Li, Raj K. Koju, Yuri Mishin
arxiv-2411-01672.description: Abstract Molecular dynamics and parallel-replica dynamics simulations are applied to investigate the atomic structures and diffusion processes at Al ​ { 111 } | Si ​ { 111 } {\text{Al}\{111\}}\parallel{\text{Si}}\{111\} interphase boundaries constructed by simulated vapor deposition of Al(Si) alloy on Si(111) substrates. Different orientation relationships and interface structures are obtained for different pre-deposition Si (111) surface reconstructions.

arxiv-2502-15863.title: Hartree-Fock approximation for bosons with symmetry-adapted variational wave functions
arxiv-2502-15863.creator: B. R. Que, J. M. Zhang, H. F. Song, Y. Liu
arxiv-2502-15863.description: Abstract The Hartree-Fock approximation for bosons employs variational wave functions that are a combination of permanents. These are bosonic counterpart of the fermionic Slater determinants, but with the significant distinction that the single-particle orbitals used to construct a permanent can be arbitrary and do not need to be orthogonal to each other.

arxiv-2505-16173.title: Exact Expansion Formalism for Transport Properties of Heterogeneous Materials Characterized by Arbitrary Continuous Random Fields
arxiv-2505-16173.creator: Liyu Zhong, Sheng Mao
arxiv-2505-16173.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Liyu Zhong, Sheng Mao. We derive an exact contrast‐expansion formalism for the effective conductivity of heterogeneous materials (media) with local properties described by arbitrary continuous random fields, significantly generalizing the widely used binary-field models. The theory produces a rapidly convergent Neumann‐series that, upon Gaussian closure via a Hermite expansion, yields closed‐form first-, second‐ and third‐order approximations, which achieve percent‐level accuracy at first order for isotropic media.

arxiv-2509-26189.title: VietBinoculars: A Zero-Shot Approach for Detecting Vietnamese LLM-Generated Text
arxiv-2509-26189.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . The rapid development research of Large Language Models (LLMs) based on transformer architectures raises key challenges, one of which being the task of distinguishing between human-written text and LLM-generated text. As LLM-generated textual content, becomes increasingly complex over time, and resembles human writing, traditional detection methods are proving less effective, especially when the number and diversity of LLMs continue to grow with new models and versions being released at a rapid pace.

arxiv-2601-00674.creator: Kei Yuen Chan
arxiv-2601-00674.description: Abstract . Let F F be a non-Archimedean local field. For an irreducible smooth representation π \pi of GL n ​ ( F ) \mathrm{GL}_{n}(F) and a multisegment 𝔪 \mathfrak{m} , one associates a simple quotient D 𝔪 ​ ( π ) D_{\mathfrak{m}}(\pi) of a Bernstein-Zelevinsky derivative of π \pi .

pmc-10608734.creator: Robert F Tournier, Michael I Ojovan, Lin Zhang, Zhitong Bai
pmc-10608734.description: Many endothermic liquid–liquid transitions, occurring at a temperature Tn+ above the melting temperature Tm, are related to previous exothermic transitions, occurring at a temperature Tx after glass formation below Tg, with or without attached crystallization and predicted by the nonclassical homogenous nucleation equation. A new thermodynamic phase composed of broken bonds (configurons), driven by percolation thresholds, varying from ~0.

pmc-10755555.title: Mental health effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on children and young adults: empirical analysis of the past, present and the way forward
pmc-10755555.creator: Mayank Gupta
pmc-10755555.description: SummaryThe SARS-CoV-2 virus and its variants have had and are having serious implications for the mental health of the public. The critical limitations in the published literature for children, adolescents and young adults raise doubts about their clinical utility and overall generalisability.

pmc-11480391.title: Comparison of a new type of Dark Matter with the Milky Way and M31 grand rotation curves
pmc-11480391.creator: Bruce M Law
pmc-11480391.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In the electron Born self-energy (eBse) model, free electrons are of finite-size and possess both a rest mass, me, as well as, a Born mass, meB = 74,000 me. The Born mass, which originates from the energy contained within the electric field that surrounds a finite-sized electron, serves as a Dark Matter (DM) particle in this theory (designated eBDM, electron Born Dark Matter).

pmc-11503054.title: Predictors for severe persisting pain in rheumatoid arthritis are associated with pain origin and appraisal of pain
pmc-11503054.creator: Christoph Baerwald, Edgar Stemmler, Sixten Gnüchtel, Katharina Jeromin, Björn Fritz, Michael Bernateck, Daniela Adolf, Peter C Taylor, Ralf Baron, PAIN-CONTROL Study Group
pmc-11503054.description: ObjectivesTo determine the proportion of patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) with severe persisting pain and to identify predictive factors despite treatment-controlled disease activity.MethodsThis prospective multicentre study included outpatients with RA scheduled for escalation of anti-inflammatory treatment due to active disease and severe pain (Disease Activity Score 28 (DAS28)>3.2 and Visual Analogue Scale (VAS)>50).

pmc-11632396.title: Gene Expression Profiling of Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Arising From Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasms of the Pancreas
pmc-11632396.creator: William A. Ziaziaris, Christopher S. H. Lim, Loretta Sioson, Anthony J. Gill, Jaswinder S. Samra, Sumit Sahni, Anubhav Mittal
pmc-11632396.description: IntroductionIntraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs) are diverse premalignant tumors of the pancreas. They progress stepwise from adenoma to carcinoma and offer an opportunity for intervention prior to malignant transformation into pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). The current study aimed to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in invasive PDAC‐associated IPMN vs.

pmc-12447270.title: Accelerating wound healing by biomineralizing crystallization formed from ZIF-8/PLA nanofibers with enhanced revascularization and inflammation reduction
pmc-12447270.creator: Xiangsheng Wang, Xueer Zhang, Bingqian Wang, Zhixiang Tan, Mulan Chen, Haiyan Shen, Hanxiao Cheng, Zhentao Zhou, Zhanyong Zhu, Jing Guo, Jufang Zhang
pmc-12447270.description: IntroductionPolylactic acid (PLA) is a synthetic polymer material with good biodegradability, biocompatibility, and bioabsorbability, electrospinning is a convenient and efficient method for preparing PLA nanofibers as wound dressing. However, PLA nanofibers as wound dressings lack biological functions, including promoting angiogenesis, extracellular matrix secretion and regulating inflammation, which are crucial for skin regeneration.

pmc-12511731.title: The Anterior Cartilage Edge of the Lateral Femoral Condyle Medial Wall is a Useful Landmark to Avoid Tunnel Convergence in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction With Lateral Extra-Articular Tenodesis
pmc-12511731.creator: Hong-De Wang, Zhiyu Zhang, Ruilan Dai, Qingyang Meng, Shuang Ren, Yiqun Wang, Wenqiang Yan, Yingfang Ao, Cheng Wang
pmc-12511731.description: Background:There is a risk of convergence between the anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) femoral tunnel and the lateral extra-articular tenodesis (LET) tunnel, which may cause damage to the graft and fixation device.Purpose:To develop a simple and safe method for drilling the LET tunnel to avoid convergence between the ACL femoral tunnel and the LET tunnel.Study Design:Descriptive laboratory study.

pmc-12605704.title: Impact of Halogen Substituent Nature and Position on the Structural and Energetic Properties of Carbamazepine Cocrystals with Meta‐Halobenzoic Acids: A Two‐Pathway Synthesis Study
pmc-12605704.creator: Artur Mirocki, Mattia Lopresti
pmc-12605704.description: Crystal engineering provides effective strategies to produce pharmaceutical cocrystals, aimed at enhancing the physicochemical properties of active pharmaceutical ingredients. Herein, the structural and energetic properties of carbamazepine cocrystals with meta‐chlorobenzoic, meta‐bromobenzoic, and meta‐iodobenzoic acids are examined in depth, with particular focus on the influence of halogen substitution.

pmc-12615644.title: Association between modified Rankin Scale scores and fall risk in post-stroke rehabilitation inpatients: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12615644.creator: Songhui Wu, Qingfang Zhang, Jie Yan, Jianjun Long, Dianrui Hou, Yulong Wang
pmc-12615644.description: Falls are among the most common complications after stroke, potentially delaying functional recovery. Although the modified Rankin Scale (mRS) is widely used in stroke assessment, its relationship with fall risk remains poorly understood. The study aims to identify the association between mRS scores and fall risk in stroke patients.

pmc-12658207.title: AOH induces oxidative stress and DNA damage in ovarian cancer cells via modulation of GPER1 and HIF1α/PI3K/CLDNs signaling pathway
pmc-12658207.creator: Marta Justyna Kozieł-Leszczyńska, Dominika Ewa Habrowska-Górczyńska, Kacper Piotr Leszczyński, Kinga Anna Urbanek, Agnieszka Wanda Piastowska-Ciesielska, Karolina Kowalska
pmc-12658207.description: Claudins (CLDNs) are small proteins that form tight junctions (TJs) in cells and play a key role in various biological processes in cells. Previous results have shown that CLDNs expression can be regulated by hormones and, therefore, can also be regulated by compounds that mimic their action. Such compounds belong to a large group called endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs).

pmc-12704119.title: Blood pressure variability and cerebrovascular risk in maintenance hemodialysis versus peritoneal dialysis: a comparative study
pmc-12704119.creator: Ting Hu, Ting Yu, Xiao Xu, Zhuanping Huang, Zhanxing Cao, Geping Yu
pmc-12704119.description: This study aimed to compare blood pressure variability (BPV) between maintenance hemodialysis (HD) and peritoneal dialysis (PD) patients and evaluate its association with cerebrovascular event risk. A prospective cohort of 374 end-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients, including 218 on HD and 156 on PD, was enrolled between January 2020 and July 2024.

pmc-12963204.title: Mechanistic Insights from Human Studies in Axial Spondyloarthritis: A T Cell Story
pmc-12963204.creator: Joy Um, Michael A. Paley
pmc-12963204.description: Purpose of reviewAnkylosing spondylitis (AS) represents the archetype of the spondyloarthritis family defined by its strong association with HLA-B*27. While genetic susceptibility has long pointed toward adaptive immunity, the precise cellular pathways linking MHC class I alleles to axial inflammation have remained an enigma.

pmc-13556418.title: 696. Choline supplementation during pregnancy prevents cognitive impairments linked to elevated kynurenic acid
pmc-13556418.creator: A Pocivavsek, C Witt, S Milosavljevic, P L Brown, S Beggiato, R Schwarcz
pmc-13556418.description: BackgroundElevated brain kynurenic acid (KYNA) levels are implicated in the pathophysiology of schizophrenia (SZ). As an antagonist of cholinergic and glutamatergic neurotransmission, elevated KYNA levels may be causally related to cognitive dysfunctions in SZ. We developed an embryonic kynurenine model (“EKyn”; Beggiato et al., 2018) in mice to mimic elevated KYNA levels during neurodevelopment and study cognitive function in adulthood.
